message.content:
This is a modular sofa section: an upholstered seat with a wooden frame, covered in leather. It falls under heading 9401, seats.

Subheading 9401.61 covers upholstered seats with wooden frames, and 9401.61.40 is the other (non-convertible into beds) upholstered seat with a wooden frame. The question is whether the "Leather Storage Console" unit counts as a seat. It is a console segment with storage and cupholders, and it connects to sofa sections. CBP rulings on similar modular sectional consoles have classified them as seats under 9401.61.60.

The 9401.61 breakdown is:
- 9401.61.20: Seats of a kind used for aircraft (the 9401.10 line is separate).
- 9401.61.30: Chairs for the handicapped? Not certain.
- 9401.61.40: Other, with wooden frame, upholstered, "Other."
- 9401.61.60: Other, Other.

I recall that 9401.61.40 is "Other: Upholstered: Other: Other" ("Other" under 9401.61.40 for seats with wooden frames, 9401.61.60 for other). The actual structure in HTSUS is:
- 9401.61.20: Seats of a kind used for... (multiple)
- 9401.61.40: Other, with wooden frames: Other, "Other".
- 9401.61.60: Other

Recent rulings on leather sofa sectional units with wooden frames have used 9401.61.4011, which is "Upholstered, with wooden frames: Other: Other: Other."

Since 9401.61.40 has statistical suffix 11 for "Stationary seating? Sofas?" I will go with 9401.61.4011.
